definitions.explanation: The organ system including the heart and blood vessels that circulates blood throughout the body.

examples.japanese: {循環器|じゅんかんき}⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had tests done at the cardiology department.

{循環器|じゅんかんき}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: Maintain the health of the circulatory system.

notes:
{循環器|じゅんかんき} refers to the organ system responsible for circulating blood — primarily the heart and blood vessels. It is a medical/technical term most often encountered in hospital department names and health-related contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{循環|じゅんかん}→循環：08669_junkan⟧ (circulation) + {器|き} (organ/system)

- {循環器|じゅんかんき}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧: circulatory system
